notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put an activated or triggered ability on the stack under your control.
description:
Put an activated or triggered ability on the stack under your control.
Holding priority, cast Vantress Visions by paying {1}{U}, targeting the ability.
Phyrexian Metamorph and Lucky Clover trigger.
Resolve the Lucky Clover trigger, copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Phyrexian Metamorph's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Vantress Visions, copying Phyrexian Metamorph's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Phyrexian Metamorph's trigger, copying Vantress Visions, with the copy targeting Phyrexian Metamorph's trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.name: Phyrexian Metamorph
uses.cardState: as a copy of Lucky Clover
